text: This report provides the recommended 2022 Service Levels for Toronto Parking Authority in comparison to service levels planned and achieved from 2019 to 2021. Service levels have historically been presented in the Budget Notes for each Program/Agency for review by Budget Committee and approval by City Council. Beginning in 2020, as part of the budget modernization project, service levels were provided in a separate document in an effort to deliver a more efficient and simplified budget process that will create greater opportunities for public participation through inclusive and outcome focused budget materials.

City Council on December 15, 16 and 17, 2021, adopted the following: Operating and Capital Budgets 1.
